title: lane r6 Meth: display-ID branch naming conflicts with pre-sync provisional IDs
description: Lane round 6. Lens: methodology (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: display IDs exist only after hub sync; the amendment does not say what a generated branch carries pre-sync — the naive local-ID reading resurrects the unstable-handle defect the design forbids. Citations verified: contract:124 vs :80, :264, :289. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the registered grammar declares both forms: the vehicle's session-scoped form pre-sync, the display-ID form once sync has assigned it).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the registered grammar declares both forms — session-scoped pre-sync, display-ID post-sync; provisional local IDs never enter branch names. Revision: Conformance closed-world bullet.
